note: No loader in this repository can read Markdown as configuration (src/utils/config_loader.py:11,38 read YAML; src/strategy/business_config.py:272 reads JSON). So a .md is either HUMAN_DOCUMENTATION, or — if something declares it as executable product configuration — PRODUCT_CONFIG_UNWIRED_PARTIAL. Boundary-contract docs that accurately describe a live module are HUMAN_DOCUMENTATION; docs that describe behaviour the implementation does not satisfy are recorded with the mismatch.
